dataset_kind: frozen offline practice example; not student-selected stocks

prices.provider: Yahoo Finance adjusted daily Close via yfinance auto_adjust=True

monthly_bill_convention: For each return month use the snapshot in the immediately preceding calendar month; annual_yield_percent / 1200. Dates are inherited source-period labels, not reconstructed daily observations. Do not carry a stale snapshot forward.
cache_policy: Copied once from the existing frozen instructor sample. No new source observations, interpolation or synthetic values. For your own choices download into data_my_stocks with the separate tool.
prospective_rate_convention: Use the latest available quote in this saved rate file and disclose its source-period label. This frozen quote is not claimed to be the globally latest current quote; refresh a current quote from the same official source and record its date separately if needed.
